Kya admission ke liye commission dene jaiyz hai? 1968 views Q. "In the name of Allah, the Compassionate, the Merciful" Asalamo Alykum, I once had plans to go abroad for studies. It was such a painful dream that I woke up with tears in my eyes. I gathered from it that my father has spent much on us and much of it is from Sood. So do not pressurize him for more expenditures so that he is forced to stick to Sood. I quit my plans for study abroad, and I have been trying for him to leave all Soodi investments. But when i think that the dream said "he is already burnt" i feel perhaps it is no use. The sin has amounted so much that Allah na karae, but he will burn in hell for sure. So I get disheartened. I also get disheartened because he has started taking out money from Soodi investments upon our insistence but he does not really consider it a sin. He says it is not that kind of forbidden Sood. answer: Miscellaneous >> Halal & Haram Question ID: 151175 Country: India Title: Some schools are charging fines for not paying fees on time. Is this permissible in Islam? Please clarify in accordance to Quran, Sunnah and the fatwa of Fuqaha. Question: Some schools are charging fines for not paying fees on time. Is this permissible in Islam? Please clarify in accordance to Quran, Sunnah and the fatwa of Fuqaha. Answer ID: 151175 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 830/779/SD=9/1438) It is not lawful to impose financial penalty in case of not paying the fee in time. قال الحصكفي : لا بأخذ مال في المذهب . (رد المحتار على الدر المختار 178/ 3 ط إحياء التراث) Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
